scripts.build: yarn workspaces foreach --all --topological-dev --exclude autolight run build
scripts.test: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude autolight run test
scripts.lint: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude autolight run lint
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude autolight run typecheck
scripts.verify:phase1: yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude autolight run typecheck && uv sync --locked --project analysis && uv run --project analysis pytest -q
scripts.test:count: vitest run --reporter=json > ./node_modules/.vitest-count.json 2>/dev/null; CODE=$?; tail -1 ./node_modules/.vitest-count.json; rm -f ./node_modules/.vitest-count.json; exit $CODE
scripts.truth: node docs/finish/tools/check-coverage.mjs && node tools/capabilities-check.mjs && node tools/claim-check.mjs && node tools/forbidden-words.mjs && node tools/bundle-scan.mjs && node tools/trackmodel-drift.mjs && yarn sg scan --config tools/ast-grep/sgconfig.yml
scripts.analyze: bash -c 'yarn oxlint; OXLINT_EXIT=$?; GATE_EXIT=0; yarn knip || GATE_EXIT=$?; yarn depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs packages apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/electron || GATE_EXIT=$?; node tools/unwired-service.mjs || GATE_EXIT=$?; yarn tsc --noEmit -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.typecheck.json --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters --noImplicitReturns --noFallthroughCasesInSwitch || GATE_EXIT=$?; yarn madge --circular packages/*/src apps/desktop/src apps/desktop/electron || GATE_EXIT=$?; uv sync --locked --project analysis || GATE_EXIT=$?; uv run --project analysis ruff check analysis/src analysis/tests || GATE_EXIT=$?; uv run --project analysis pyright analysis/src/autolight_analysis || GATE_EXIT=$?; uv run --project analysis --with vulture vulture analysis/src --min-confidence 80 || GATE_EXIT=$?; if [ $OXLINT_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then echo "analyze: oxlint found findings (see above)"; exit $OXLINT_EXIT; fi; exit $GATE_EXIT'
scripts.verify:all: yarn build && yarn typecheck && yarn vitest run && uv run --project analysis pytest -q && yarn workspace @autolight/desktop test:e2e
